I just have one quick question...
Combat cards that DON'T say 'do not replace until after combat'...are they replaced immediately?
I always thought that all combat cards were not replaced until after combat
thanks

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
In Jyhad, you always replace cards immediately, unless the card tells
you to wait, or a vote is being taken.  Most of the cards which tell
you to wait are combat cards, but most combat cards don't tell you
to wait, so are replaced immediately.
